PC05-001.name: Evangelion New Unit-02 Alpha & Unit-08 Revised Gamma
PC05-001.effect:
When this card in Hand would be discarded by your "WILLE" family effect, instead of sending it to the Trash, you can summon it.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can destroy an opposing Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Nexus can't activate. Also, when summoned via an effect, you can draw two cards.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Your Attack Step)
Once per turn, during this battle, besides this Spirit, you can give one of your "New Unit-02"/"Unit-08 Revised" an extra Red symbol.

PC05-003.name: Evangelion Unit-00 & Unit-01
PC05-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit would leave the Field due to the opponent, by discarding a card from your Hand, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, either destroy an opposing Spirit, or return an opposing Burst to the deckbottom.

PC05-002.name: Evangelion Unit-00 (Revised) & Unit-02 Beast Form 2nd Phase (Type 1)
PC05-002.effect:
At the start of the opposing Attack Step, if you control any "Ayanami"/"Makinami"/"Misato", you can summon this card from the Trash. When you've done so, during this turn, the "unaffected by effects" effects of opposing Spirits can't activate. This effect can't be prevented by opposing effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Besides "The 10th Apostle", destroy an opposing Spirit with the highest BP, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit can't activate.

PC05-X01.name: Evangelion Unit-01 & Unit-13
PC05-X01.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) While an opposing Cost 7 or more Spirit/Ultimate is attacking, if you have any "Ikari" Brave/Nexus/Mirage, you can pay one cost to summon this card from the Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3][LV4]
For both players, depleted/destroyed “Evangelion"/"EVANGELION" are banished instead of being sent to the Trash.

[LV2][LV3][LV4] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By destroying this Spirit, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy every opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit/Ultimate.

PC05-005.name: Fuyutsuki Kozo
PC05-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Deployed)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, besides any “Fuyutsuki Kozo”, add a “NERV” family card, and an “Ikari Gendo”/“Ikari Yui” to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can summon/deploy an “EVANGELION”/“Spear”/“Ikari Gendo” from your Hand/Trash

PC05-004.name: The 10th Apostle -Invasion-
PC05-004.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
You can summon this card from the Hand. When summoning with this effect, for each differently-named "Angel" family card in your Trash, this card gets -1 cost (Max. -6).

[LV1][LV2][LV3] [A.T. Field] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with [Soul Core] on it.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
By returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, summon a Cost 8 or more "Angel" family Spirit card from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost.

PC04-X02.name: Ultraman Zett Delta Rise Claw ［3］
PC04-X02.effect:
Flash - [Advent: "Ultraman" & Cost 6 or more] ((Either Attack Step))
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per turn, draw three cards, then discard two cards from your Hand. For each two costs of the total cost of cards discarded by this effect, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, treat this Spirit's color as colorless, and return an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the deckbottom.
